arxiv-2205-01589.title: A dynamic mass transport method for Poisson-Nernst-Planck equations
arxiv-2205-01589.creator: Hailiang Liu and Wumaier Maimaitiyiming
arxiv-2205-01589.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Hailiang Liu and Wumaier Maimaitiyiming. A dynamic mass-transport method is proposed for approximately solving the Poisson–Nernst–Planck (PNP) equations. The semi-discrete scheme based on the JKO type variational formulation naturally enforces solution positivity and the energy law as for the continuous PNP system. The fully discrete scheme is further formulated as a constrained minimization problem, shown to be solvable, and satisfy all three solution properties (mass conservation, positivity and energy dissipation) independent of time step size or the spatial mesh size.

arxiv-2210-00225.title: Displacement smoothness of entropic optimal transport
arxiv-2210-00225.creator: Guillaume Carlier, Lénaïc Chizat, Maxime Laborde
arxiv-2210-00225.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Guillaume Carlier, Lénaïc Chizat, Maxime Laborde. The function that maps a family of probability measures to the solution of the dual entropic optimal transport problem is known as the Schrödinger map. We prove that when the cost function is 𝒞 k + 1 \mathcal{C}^{k+1} with k ∈ ℕ ∗ k\in\mathbb{N}^{*} then this map is Lipschitz continuous from the L 2 L^{2} -Wasserstein space to the space of 𝒞 k \mathcal{C}^{k} functions. Our result holds on compact domains and covers the multi-marginal case.

arxiv-2512-17062.title: Lang2Manip: A Tool for LLM-Based Symbolic-to-Geometric Planning for Manipulation Thanks: 1 Khalifa University Center for Autonomous Robotic Systems (KUCARS), Khalifa University, United Arab Emirates. Thanks: 2 Institute of Industrial and Control Engineering (IOC), Universitat Politècnica de Cataluny
arxiv-2512-17062.creator: Muhayy Ud Din, Jan Rosell, Waseem Akram, Irfan Hussain
arxiv-2512-17062.description: Abstract Simulation is essential for developing robotic manipulation systems, particularly for task and motion planning (TAMP), where symbolic reasoning interfaces with geometric, kinematic, and physics-based execution. Recent advances in Large Language Models (LLMs) enable robots to generate symbolic plans from natural language, yet executing these plans in simulation often requires robot-specific engineering or planner-dependent integration.

grant-personal-memoirs.creator: Ulysses S. Grant
grant-personal-memoirs.description: Grant's memoirs, written as he was dying of cancer — the Civil War's plain-spoken masterwork, Mark Twain's greatest publishing triumph. Edition: complete text via Project Gutenberg.

pmc-10534251.title: Adaptation and validation of the encoding of observations using CONSUL-MCC: A self-determination theory-based tool to observe consultations in maternity care
pmc-10534251.creator: Joyce Kors, Veerle Duprez, Linda Martin, Corine J. Verhoeven, Ann van Hecke, Saskia M. Peerdeman, Rashmi A. Kusurkar
pmc-10534251.description: ObjectiveDuring autonomy-supportive consultations, professionals use a need-supportive interaction style to facilitate patients' self-regulated behaviour. To improve maternity care professionals' need-supportive interactions, it is important to provide insights into their interaction style. No tool is currently available for measuring need-supportive interactions in maternity care.

pmc-10558815.title: Impact of venous thromboembolism on the mortality in patients with cancer: a population-based cohort study
pmc-10558815.creator: Henrik Toft Sørensen, Lars Pedersen, Nick van Es, Harry R Büller, Erzsébet Horváth-Puhó
pmc-10558815.description: SummaryBackgroundDespite recent improvements in the treatment of cancer, little is known about the long-term survival in patients with cancer and venous thromboembolism. We aimed to examine the five-year mortality of venous thromboembolism in cancer patients in a large population-based cohort study.

pmc-10661414.title: Disease activity in primary progressive multiple sclerosis: a systematic review and meta-analysis
pmc-10661414.creator: Katelijn M. Blok, Joost van Rosmalen, Nura Tebayna, Joost Smolders, Beatrijs Wokke, Janet de Beukelaar
pmc-10661414.description: BackgroundDisease activity in multiple sclerosis (MS) is defined as presence of relapses, gadolinium enhancing lesions and/or new or enlarging lesions on MRI. It is associated with efficacy of immunomodulating therapies (IMTs) in primary progressive MS (PPMS). However, a thorough review on disease activity in PPMS is lacking. In relapsing remitting MS, the prevalence of activity decreases in more contemporary cohorts.

pmc-11046609.title: The rare umbilical nodule
pmc-11046609.creator: Jegadis Sreeneyasan, Divya Kanakalingam, Rajinder Gupta
pmc-11046609.description: A 79-year-old woman with no significant past medical history presented to the medical assessment unit (MAU) with dysphagia and reduced appetite for 3 weeks and with significant weight loss over last 3 months. She had also noted an umbilical swelling in the last month which she ignored.

pmc-11436754.title: Deep learning prediction of electrospray ionization tandem mass spectra of chemically derived molecules
pmc-11436754.creator: Bin Chen, Hailiang Li, Rongfu Huang, Yanan Tang, Feng Li
pmc-11436754.description: Chemical derivatization is a powerful strategy to enhance sensitivity and selectivity of liquid chromatography-mass spectrometry for non-targeted analysis of chemicals in complex mixtures. However, it remains impossible to obtain large sets of reference spectra for chemically derived molecules (CDMs), representing a major barrier in real-world applications.

pmc-11678512.title: Admixture of Liposomal Bupivacaine and Bupivacaine Hydrochloride for Peripheral Nerve Blocks in Adolescents Undergoing Orthopedic Surgery: An Observational Cohort Study
pmc-11678512.creator: Benjamin P. Fiorillo, M. Stephen Melton, Derek Nelsen, Lisa M. Einhorn
pmc-11678512.description: Background/Objectives: In 2021, the Food and Drug Administration approved liposomal bupivacaine injectable suspension for single-dose infiltration in patients ≥ 6 years of age. Liposomal bupivacaine and bupivacaine hydrochloride admixtures may also be administered off-label for pediatric regional anesthesia including peripheral nerve blocks (PNBs).

pmc-11689004.title: MULTIMORBIDITY PATTERNS PREDICT THE ORDER OF PHYSICAL FRAILTY AND COGNITIVE IMPAIRMENT OCCURRENCE
pmc-11689004.creator: Shuomin Wang, Qianyuan Li, Qian-Li Xue, Minhui Liu
pmc-11689004.description: Prior studies showed the difference in temporal sequence of physical frailty and cognitive impairment occurrence. Chronic conditions often co-occur in specific disease patterns, that is multimorbidity patterns, revealing shared pathophysiological mechanisms and risk factors. However, whether different multimorbidity patterns predict the order of frailty and cognitive impairment occurrence remain unknown.

pmc-12560256.title: Near‐normal ultrasound morphology in quadriceps tendon after anterior cruciate ligament graft harvest
pmc-12560256.creator: Jumpei Inoue, Kohei Kamada, Keishi Takaba, M Enes Kayaalp, Joseph D Giusto, Bryson P Lesniak, Andrew L Sprague, Volker Musahl
pmc-12560256.description: PurposeThe quadriceps tendon (QT) autograft is increasingly used for anterior cruciate ligament reconstruction (ACLR) due to favourable clinical outcomes. However, the long‐term morphological and vascular changes at the QT harvest site remain unclear. This study aimed to evaluate QT morphology and vascularity using ultrasound at least 1 year after ACLR.

pmc-12642280.title: scKGBERT: a knowledge-enhanced foundation model for single-cell transcriptomics
pmc-12642280.creator: Yang Li, Guanyu Qiao, Hongli Du, Xin Gao, Guohua Wang
pmc-12642280.description: Single-cell transcriptomics enables precise characterization of cellular heterogeneity, but current pre-trained models relying solely on expression data fail to capture gene associations. We present scKGBERT, a knowledge-enhanced foundation model integrating 41 M single-cell RNA-seq profiles and 8.9 M protein–protein interactions to jointly learn gene and cell representations.

pmc-12817723.title: Long-term quality of life in non-epithelial ovarian cancer survivors: TMRG-GINECO-Vivrovaire rare tumors case–control study
pmc-12817723.creator: Coraline Dubot, Isabelle Ray-Coquard, Justine Lequesne, Patricia Pautier, Tiphaine Renaud, Frédéric Selle, Dominique Berton-Rigaud, Sophie Frank, Thibault De La Motte Rouge, Elsa Kalbacher, Magali Provansal, Cyriac Blonz, Hubert Orfeuvre, Jérôme Alexandre, Paule Augereau, Cédric Nadeau, Jean-Emmanue
pmc-12817723.description: BackgroundPatients treated for rare ovarian germ cell tumors (GCT) and sex cord stromal tumors (SCST) often experience long-term survival. Treatments include surgery with or without chemotherapy (CT), which can cause late side effects that negatively impact quality of life (QoL).

pmc-13129386.title: From 0D to 3D: Carbon-based materials and their electrocatalytic CO2 reduction performance
pmc-13129386.creator: Xu Wang, Xiao-jing Liu, Di Wang, Rui-tang Guo
pmc-13129386.description: SummaryThis review summarizes recent advances in carbon-based materials for the electrocatalytic CO2 reduction reaction (CO2RR), focusing on the core innovation of structure-performance relationships in zero-to-three-dimensional carbon architectures and their regulatory mechanisms. Heteroatom doping and defect engineering are identified as key strategies to modulate local electronic environments, optimize intermediate binding, and enhance catalytic activity/selectivity.

pmc-13523285.title: Surgical anatomy, biomechanics and clinical outcomes of latissimus dorsi transfer for irreparable rotator cuff tears: a review
pmc-13523285.creator: Jean Michel Hovsepian, Marco A Cartaya, Johannes Glaser, Nicola Oehler, Igor Solovyov, Charbel Abi Mansour, Julio Carruyo Avila, Stephan Vogt
pmc-13523285.description: BackgroundLatissimus dorsi transfer is a well-established joint-preserving option for irreparable rotator cuff tears in young, active patients without glenohumeral arthritis. Originally described by Gerber in 1988 for posterosuperior tears, indications now also include anterosuperior reconstruction, either as isolated transfer to the lesser tuberosity or in combination with the teres major.
